time_base: 8760 exact source UTC model hours, calendar 2023 not observed 2022/2024
observed_price_source: ENTSO-E A44 original NL 2023 day-ahead; source PyNEXUS verified exact ZIP and historical hourly price data provider
observed_wind_source: ERA5 2023 model-derived wind available at source historic 52.5N 3.5E offshore resource sampling coordinates, NOT a storage/industrial customer
checked_underlying_source_model: full 8760h E/E+S original equal H2 service pressure-sieved HiGHS MILP with original PEM/load/ramp storage terminal and source compressor charge cost, preserve source initial/terminal 10t

scenario_catalog.market_transform: 2023 original price sequence re-indexed by +168h circular roll, exact original price marginal distribution
scenario_catalog.causal_meaning: break 2023 price-wind phase correlations while preserving empirical hourly price values; artificial timing counterfactual not 2023 real event

scenario_catalog.market_transform: median of original 2023 price +1.5*(original price-median), possible negative price preserved
scenario_catalog.causal_meaning: assumed higher within-year electricity price dispersion without a new observed year; not a statistical confidence bound

scenario_catalog.wind_transform: original 2023 ERA5-model wind available ×0.90 for each hour (not 2024 observed)
scenario_catalog.causal_meaning: systematically lower resource/PyNEXUS wind availability; may render exact original 2023 H2 target infeasible

scenario_catalog.wind_transform: original 2023 ERA5-model wind available ×1.10 each hour, no turbine-rated-cap guarantee
scenario_catalog.causal_meaning: systematically more energy availability, curtailment possible; not a re-run of wind-power curve on new 100m ERA5 velocities

global_optimality_requirement: SciPy HiGHS 1e-6 relative MIP gap source lower/feasible upper; if not attained label UNKNOWN certified preference
infeasibility_policy: If either E or E+S cannot serve original identical H2 hour profile, report infeasibility independently, no numeric matched-service annual saving value
